description.name: Entry
description.text: Eight group attacks (1.68 each), smart ether 1 to the user, grants [Haste], [Attach Holy] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
